_doc: AIMEAT_* names that code under src/ reads and that have no row in CONFIG_FIELDS, each with the reason it is not a setting of this node or why it has no row of its own. Every other name the node reads is on the admin Config tab. `pnpm check:config-coverage --strict` fails on a NEW name with no row and no entry here, on an entry whose name now has a row, on an entry for a name nothing reads, and on an entry that is still the 2026-08-16 seeding's placeholder. The seeded backlog was emptied on 2026-10-25. A new entry is a decision for the developer.

exempt.AIMEAT_AGENT_NAME: Not a node setting: the `aimeat connect` program on a person's own computer reads it (src/cli/connect/auth.ts) to name the agent it registers.
exempt.AIMEAT_AGENT_TOKEN: Not a node setting: a publish script the workstation app template writes into a developer's own project reads it (src/data/app-templates/workstation.ts).
exempt.AIMEAT_BASE: Not a node setting: `aimeat screenshot-worker`, a command an operator runs against a node from any machine, reads the node's address from it (src/cli/screenshot-worker.ts).
exempt.AIMEAT_HOME: Not a node setting: the `aimeat connect` program sets and reads it for the client it installs on a person's own computer (src/cli/connect/clients/index.ts).
exempt.AIMEAT_INSTALL_NAME: Not a node setting: the `aimeat connect` program reads it to name its install on a person's own computer (src/cli/connect/install-id.ts).
exempt.AIMEAT_OP_TOKEN: Not a node setting: `aimeat screenshot-worker` reads the operator token it calls the node with (src/cli/screenshot-worker.ts).
exempt.AIMEAT_RUNTIME_FEATURES: Not a node setting: the `aimeat connect` program reports which runtime features its machine has (src/cli/connect/runtime-features.ts).
exempt.AIMEAT_RUN_MODES: Not a node setting: the `aimeat connect` program reports which run modes its machine offers (src/cli/connect/run-modes.ts).
exempt.AIMEAT_SITE_KV_: A name prefix, not a variable: every AIMEAT_SITE_KV_<NAME> adds one site value (src/config-runtime.ts siteKvFromEnv). The Config tab row is site.kv (AIMEAT_SITE_KV), which holds the same pairs.
exempt.AIMEAT_SITE_CONTACT_EMAIL: The single-contact fallback, read only when AIMEAT_SITE_CONTACTS is unset or unparseable. The Config tab row is site.contacts (the list); a second row for the same people would be two places to edit one fact.

exempt.AIMEAT_TEST_MONEY_HANDLER: REVIEWED 2026-10-13 — kept out of the Config tab ON PURPOSE, and must never get a CONFIG_FIELDS row: it registers a payment handler that completes EUR and USD payments with no real money. It is an environment variable the operator sets on purpose; on a non-loopback AIMEAT_BASE_URL the start log and the Security page report it as critical (utils/test-money-guard.ts); test/unit/test-money-guard.test.ts fails if a row is added.
